_comment: Copy this file to 'config.json' next to the Server and Indexer executables, then edit. config.json is gitignored because it can hold a SQL connection string and tokens. All values are strings (the loader parses numbers/bools).
_comment_models: EmbeddingDimension must match the embedding model: 1024 for the local e5-large-v2 ONNX below, 1536 for the hosted bge-code-v1 HF endpoint (the code default). Changing models requires a full reindex.
_comment_huggingface: Optional: embed + rank via Hugging Face Inference Endpoints instead of local ONNX (this is how the hosted demo runs: BAAI/bge-code-v1 embeddings on TEI + Qwen3-Reranker-4B-seq-cls on vLLM). Set the two URLs below (and EmbeddingDimension to 1536 for bge-code-v1), then store the token with 'Server --set-secret HF_TOKEN hf_xxx' (or the HF_TOKEN env var). Leave the URLs blank to use the local ONNX models above.
_comment_maxvectordistance: SAFETY RAIL, not a relevance filter (use MinRerankScore for relevance). Cosine-distance ceiling (0..2] for vector candidates entering RRF, applied INSIDE VECTOR_SEARCH — so a value below the model's real NL-to-code distance floor empties the vector leg with no error and search silently degrades to full-text. Measured with bge-code-v1 on a code corpus, EVERY distance falls in 0.67-0.90 whether or not the hit is relevant, so a tighter ceiling drops good results before bad ones. The old 0.5 was an e5-large-v2 value that was inert there (e5 runs 0.13-0.22) and discarded ~everything once the model changed. Re-measure per model AND corpus before tightening.
_comment_minrerankscore: Relevance gate: minimum cross-encoder rerank score a result must reach to be returned. Unlike distance, the reranker separates cleanly — measured on-topic hits score 0.14-0.99, off-topic ones 0.0-0.0013. 0.001 sits inside that gap, so a question the corpus cannot answer returns few results or none instead of padding to NResults with noise. Set 0 to disable. Skipped entirely when the reranker is unavailable, so a reranker outage cannot empty every search.
